name: The Golden Chaos Award
citation: Presented to Aarna for exceptional and relentless contributions to unnecessary classroom chaos, spontaneous giggles, and dismantling teacher seriousness.
juryRemarks: Awarded by unanimous vote of the Committee for Desk Disorder. No other human was considered.

name: International Award for Random Behaviour
citation: For the unprecedented ability to transition from philosophical silence to extreme theatrical drama in under 1.4 seconds.
juryRemarks: Subject's behavioral predictability remains at 0.00%, setting an all-time institutional world record.

name: Lifetime Achievement in Pretending to Be Innocent
citation: For perfecting the 'Who, me? I'm just an innocent angel!' wide-eyed facial expression immediately after executing mischievous chaos.
juryRemarks: The jury was completely fooled until visual evidence (video call doodles) surfaced.

name: Excellence in Confusing Researchers
citation: Conferred upon Aarna for defeating 14 consecutive diagnostic algorithms designed to predict normal human responses.
juryRemarks: Algorithms gave up and recommended simply bringing her dessert instead.

name: The PGli Gawar Special Recognition Award
citation: For wearing the title of 'PGli Gawar' with unmatched grace, reminding everyone that authentic foolishness with a pure heart beats fake sophistication every single time.
juryRemarks: Presented with eternal sisterly love, endless respect, and an unbreakable bond.
